data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to listen for all incoming notifications on Android.
data.what_it_does: Allows Android applications to listen to incoming status bar notifications in real-time. It supports running background callbacks, interactive notification actions, and auto-starting after device reboots.
use_when: You need to build a notification reader, custom notification log, or automation app on Android.
You need to handle or reply to incoming notifications from other apps programmatically.
avoid_when: You need to support platforms other than Android (e.g., iOS).
You only want to send local or push notifications to your own app.
strengths: Supports background execution via static callback functions.
Provides access to notification fields, icons, actions, and quick replies.
Supports auto-starting the service after system reboot.
weaknesses: Requires manual setup of Android Manifest permissions and service configuration.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the NotificationsHandlerService and specific permissions (WAKE_LOCK, FOREGROUND_SERVICE, POST_NOTIFICATIONS, etc.) to AndroidManifest.xml, plus requesting notification permissions at runtime.
